UiCustomizationProfile.title: UiCustomizationProfile
UiCustomizationProfile.description: Stores user UI customization settings, neon theme selection, element distribution, icon formatting, and custom visual style presets synced across devices.

profileName.description: Display name of the customization profile or custom style preset.

neonThemeId.description: Active neon theme identifier among the 6 neon dark themes.

layoutMode.description: Distribution layout mode for manga cards.

iconStyle.description: Visual formatting style for icons across the interface.

navigationBarStyle.description: Style and placement of the navigation bar.

homeSectionOrder.description: Order of sections on the home/explore screen.

cardCornerRadiusDp.description: Corner radius in dp for manga cards (8 to 28).

neonGlowIntensity.description: Intensity percentage of neon glow effects (0 to 100).

deviceName.description: Name of the device that last synced this profile.

isActive.description: Whether this profile is the currently active synced UI configuration.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

MangaBookmark.title: MangaBookmark
MangaBookmark.description: Stores a manga entry in the user's personal Kotatsu/SSS cloud-synced library.

sourceName.description: Manga catalogue source (e.g., MangaDex, Kotatsu Arabic, Asura).

lastReadChapter.description: Last chapter number read by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when added via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ReadingSessionLog.title: ReadingSessionLog
ReadingSessionLog.description: Stores usage analytics and reading telemetry for continuous UX optimization.

mangaTitle.description: Title of the manga read during the session.

minutesSpent.description: Duration of the reading session in minutes (1 to 1440).

pagesRead.description: Number of manga pages/panels read during the session.

chaptersCompleted.description: Number of chapters completed in this session.

neonThemeUsed.description: Neon theme active during the session.

layoutModeUsed.description: Layout mode active during the session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when logged via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/ui_profiles/{profileId}.description: Cloud-synced custom UI profiles, layout distributions, icon styles, and 6-neon themes per user.

/users/{userId}/library/{mangaId}.description: User's personal manga library bookmarks and reading progress.

/users/{userId}/reading_sessions/{sessio.description: User's reading telemetry and usage analytics logs.
